_note: Everything here is a description of sources. 'code_status' is about code only. Whether data exists is decided ONLY by reports/status_<planet>.md (generated from files on disk).

datasets.community_rule: tried per variable in order AG, RE, SB; first accepted is recorded in the file name, log and status
datasets.units_rule: read from API response 'parameters' block (solar units depend on community)
datasets.code_status: written, not run against the real API

datasets.download: earthaccess; zip -> .hgt (must be 25,934,402 bytes) -> GeoTIFF -> mosaic/crop

datasets.crs: not stated on catalog page; read from file
datasets.code_status: written, not run against USGS. Old MOLA 463 m URL REMOVED (it was a guess)

datasets.scale: int16 raw * 0.5 = metres (applied once at processing)

not_implemented: Moon solar/pressure/wind (no atmosphere; no dataset verified)
